scope: Commit-35 cache-layer enumeration and detach-count diagnostic

detach_count_diagnostic.source_rule: Cache.detach_from_model assigns len(model.get_cache_layers()) to model_num_layers, then formats a mismatched-count assertion message with model_num_layers().
detach_count_diagnostic.trigger: Assertions are enabled and detach_from_model is called with a model whose cache-layer count differs from the cache's count.
detach_count_diagnostic.expected: The assertion reports the incompatible integer layer counts.
detach_count_diagnostic.actual_by_source: Formatting the failure message calls the integer and raises TypeError before AssertionError can carry the intended diagnostic.
detach_count_diagnostic.reach: Whole-tree search at this commit found no direct caller of detach_from_model; the method is mentioned in the Cache constructor docstring.
detach_count_diagnostic.control: Cache.attach_to_model has the analogous count assertion and formats model_num_layers without calling it.

cache_indexing_limit.source_rule: Cache layers follow get_cache_layers traversal order, while attention consumers retrieve them by layer_idx.
cache_indexing_limit.established_scope: The three in-tree model classes construct one cache-capable attention module per block in order.
cache_indexing_limit.limit: Compatibility with a different cache-capable traversal layout was not established.

lru_cache_limit.source_rule: Model.get_cache_layers is an instance method decorated with functools.lru_cache and returns a mutable list.
lru_cache_limit.standard_library_consequence: The function-level cache keys include self, retaining recently queried model instances up to the cache capacity and returning the same list object for repeated calls.
lru_cache_limit.limit: Runtime impact for model creation, disposal or mutation was not executed or assessed.
